data.name: Manifold Tricks
data.description: The mesmerist can have %1 tricks implanted at a time. Each creature can still be the subject of only one trick at a time. If the mesmerist implants a new trick while he already has his maximum number of concurrent tricks implanted, he must choose one implanted trick to dismiss without triggering (the dismissed trick still expends a daily use of the mesmerist's tricks).|ManifoldTricksCount
